entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.GeminiDataAnalytics.V1 version 2.2.0

New features

  • Add ListMessagesRequest.pending_write_wait_skipped to skip waiting for in-flight writes on the most recent turn

Documentation improvements

  • Clarify BigQuery Agent Analytics field behavior and validation on DataAgent

Google.Cloud.Dataform.V1 version 1.4.0

New features

  • API regeneration: 20261112T170133Z (#16101)
  • Added method CreateWorkspaceLongRunning and message CreateWorkspaceMetadata to service Dataform to create workspaces asynchronously

Google.Cloud.Firestore version 4.7.0

Bug fixes

  • Enforce maximum retry attempts on expired transactions

Google.Cloud.Run.V2 version 2.21.0

New features

  • Add ambient_networking to Service
  • Add workload_identity_config to Service and Jobs to support Agent Identity
  • Add sandbox_launcher and sandboxes fields to support launching sandboxes from a container
  • Add functional_type to Service and Job
  • Add ssh_enabled to Service and Instance
  • Add inlined_source to SourceCode
  • Add SourceUpload service with UploadSource RPC
  • Add UpdateInstance and IAM policy RPCs, restart_policy and default_uri_disabled to Instance
  • Add instance_reason to Condition
  • Add delay_execution to ExecutionTemplate and RunJobRequest overrides
  • Add force_new_revision to UpdateServiceRequest
  • Add cpu_utilization and concurrency_utilization to RevisionScaling
  • Add client and client_version to RevisionTemplate, ExecutionTemplate and WorkerPoolRevisionTemplate
  • Make service_id, job_id, worker_pool_id and instance_id optional in create requests

Documentation improvements

  • Update comments for Instances, Instance, Container, VolumeMount, CloudSqlInstance, GCSVolumeSource, launch_stage, worker_pool, and the resource ID fields in create requests

Google.Cloud.PubSub.V1 version 3.40.0

New features

  • Add ZSTD to Compression.CompressionAlgorithm

Bug fixes

  • Prevent unobserved task exception on stream close and shutdown

Google.Cloud.OracleDatabase.V1 version 1.10.0

New features

  • Add UpdateOdbDnsZone to update labels of an ODB DNS Zone
  • Add Workload Identity Connector, DatabaseConnection, ExecuteSql, FlexComponent, DbSystemComputePerformance and Update RPCs to the Oracle Database v1 API

Documentation improvements

  • Update field comments to note immutable and input-only fields on Oracle Database v1 resources and Update requests

Google.Cloud.Kms.V1 version 3.28.0

New features

  • Add enum attestation format for additional firmware

Google.Cloud.DiscoveryEngine.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta26

New features

  • Add ProvisionIntent, pre_provision_mode, provision_intent and idp_config to ProvisionProjectRequest in v1 and v1beta
  • Add locations HTTP binding to ProjectService.ProvisionProject in v1beta

Google.Cloud.DiscoveryEngine.V1 version 1.19.0

New features

  • Add ProvisionIntent, pre_provision_mode, provision_intent and idp_config to ProvisionProjectRequest in v1 and v1beta
  • Add locations HTTP binding to ProjectService.ProvisionProject in v1beta

Google.Cloud.Dataform.V1Beta1 version 1.0.0-beta17

New features

  • API regeneration: 20261112T170133Z (#16101)
  • Added method CreateWorkspaceLongRunning and message CreateWorkspaceMetadata to service Dataform to create workspaces asynchronously
